resource_load.note: 2 DB queries: release lookup + attachment lookup
release lookup + LoadAttributes (loads repo, publisher, attachments)

performance_issues.description: LoadAttributes loads full release data (repo, publisher, all attachments) when only attachments are needed
performance_issues.impact: Extra DB queries for repo and publisher that are not used in the response
performance_issues.recommendation: Load only attachments directly instead of full LoadAttributes

optimization_recommendations.description: Replace LoadAttributes with direct attachment query for this endpoint
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Eliminate 1-2 unnecessary DB queries per request
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use GetAttachmentsByReleaseID or similar direct query

performance_issues.description: Storage write operation has no explicit timeout configured
performance_issues.impact: Large file uploads to slow storage could block request thread indefinitely
performance_issues.recommendation: Add context timeout for storage operations

optimization_recommendations.description: Add timeout to storage save operation
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevent request thread blocking on slow storage

performance_issues.description: Storage file deletion is synchronous on the request path
performance_issues.impact: If storage is slow, delete response is delayed
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider async file deletion after DB record is removed

optimization_recommendations.implementation: Queue file deletion after DB record removal
